data.name: Muhaddith
data.long_meaning: Muhaddith is an Arabic name that refers to a scholar who specializes in the study and narration of Hadith, the sayings and actions of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
data.spiritual_meaning: A Muhaddith is a guardian of Islamic tradition and a keeper of the Prophet's legacy.
data.numerology_meaning: A teacher, healer, and nurturer, Muhaddith has a deep inner sense of compassion for others. He is a generous, loving, caring, and affectionate person, willing to help others through thick and thin. Muhaddith is a great listener, kind and understanding, allowing others to express themselves, while being supportive and accepting.

in_arabic.name: محدث
in_arabic.meaning: المحدث هو الشخص الذي يروي الحديث النبوي
in_arabic.long_meaning: المحدث هو الشخص الذي يروي الحديث النبوي ويفسره ويحفظه من التغيير أو التحريف، وهو شخص ذو علم ودراية بالسنة النبوية ويفهمها فهماً صحيحاً، ويعتبر المحدثون من أهم الشخصيات في علم الحديث النبوي.

in_urdu.name: محدث
in_urdu.meaning: وہ شخص جو حدیث نبوی کو روایت کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: محدث وہ شخص ہے جو حدیث نبوی کو روایت کرتا ہے، اس کی تشریح کرتا ہے، اور اسے محفوظ رکھتا ہے تاکہ وہ تبدیل یا تحریف نہ ہو، محدث علم و آگاہی کے حامل ہوتے ہیں اور سنت نبوی کو صحیح طور پر سمجھتے ہیں، اسلامی تاریخ و ثقافت میں محدثین کی بہت اہمیت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुहद्दिथ
in_hindi.meaning: वह व्यक्ति जो पैगंबर की हदीस को बयान करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुहद्दिथ वह व्यक्ति है जो पैगंबर की हदीस को बयान करता है, उसकी व्याख्या करता है, और उसे सुरक्षित रखता है ताकि वह बदला या गलत न हो, मुहद्दिथ लोग विद्वान और ज्ञानी होते हैं और पैगंबर की सुन्नत को सही ढंग से समझते हैं, इस्लामी परंपरा में मुहद्दिथों का बहुत महत्व है।

in_pashto.name: محدث
in_pashto.meaning: هغه څوک چې د پېغمبر حديث بيانوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: محدث هغه څوک دی چې د پېغمبر حديث بيانوي، ده تعبير کوي، او هغه خوندي ساتي چې بدلون يا تحريف پکې نه رامنځ ته شي، محدثين علم او پوهاوي لرونکي دي او د پېغمبر سنت يې په سمه توګه پوهوي، د افغانستان او پښتون قوم په اسلامي تاريخ او کلتور کې محدثين ډېر اهميت لري.

in_english.name: Muhaddith
in_english.meaning: A person who narrates and interprets the Hadith of the Prophet
in_english.long_meaning: The term Muhaddith refers to a scholar who narrates, explains, and preserves the Hadith (sayings and actions of the Prophet Muhammad) with accuracy and authenticity. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'ḥ-d-th' (حدث), meaning 'to happen' or 'to occur', the Muhaddith plays a critical role in Islamic scholarship, particularly in the field of Hadith studies. Throughout Islamic history, Muhaddiths have been essential in maintaining the integrity and transmission of Prophetic traditions.

A Muhaddith is regarded as an authority on Hadith and plays a crucial role in preserving and transmitting the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) to future generations.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Muhaddith holds profound spiritual significance as well, as it represents a deep connection to the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and his teachings. A Muhaddith is not just an academic scholar but also a spiritual guide, devoted to understanding and sharing the wisdom and guidance of the Prophet (PBUH) to help people lead virtuous lives according to Islamic principles. The title Muhaddith serves as a reminder of the importance of seeking knowledge, preserving tradition, and keeping the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) alive in the heart of the Muslim community.
